description: Shared khanary program library — JSON dispatch programs, stdlib ops, GPU kernels, training loops, MCP tools, and the programs.psm1 bus. Consumed by modules, apps, runtimes, servers, users, and games.

structure.root: 70+ JSON programs — dispatch targets, GPU kernels, model configs, fold maps
structure.tools/: MCP.ps1, kxc_compile.ps1, tool_registry.json (34 KB), jrom_replay.py, replay/tool-events.jsonl
structure.micronauts/: program-local µ definitions (MICRONAUTS.ebnf, cluster_node, neural_pipeline, xjson-ml, etc.)

how_to_use.psm1: Import-Module programs/programs.psm1 — exposes Invoke-Program, Get-ProgramManifest, Dispatch-Fold
how_to_use.json: Pass program JSON path to kuhul_dispatch.json dispatcher or to kuhul-server /programs route
how_to_use.mcp: programs/tools/MCP.ps1 exposes 180+ MCP routes — source it in any PS session

contributing: Add .json programs to programs/ root; add MCP routes to tools/MCP.ps1; update manifest.json index. New GPU kernels: add .kuhul source + compile with kxc_compile.ps1.
